subject: .skills/fleet-cluster-lld
verdict: Solid data-gathering architecture; main gaps are missing headless mode, unreferenced template asset, and no validation gate before composing a customer-facing deliverable.
summary: The skill is impressively lean at 892 tokens with a well-drawn intelligence-placement boundary — scripts handle extraction, the model owns synthesis. However, three high-severity issues (structural H1/H2 error, missing headless mode, missing data-sufficiency validation) and a pattern of duplicated/disconnected content (inline section list, unreferenced template, hardcoded branding) prevent a higher grade.

themes.title: Disconnected template and duplicated section enumeration
themes.root_cause: lld-template.md exists but is never loaded; the 15-item section list in SKILL.md duplicates the authoritative ordering in references/lld-sections.md, wasting tokens and creating a shadow that would block future customization overrides.
themes.action: Wire assets/lld-template.md as the structural scaffold in Document Composition; remove the inline section enumeration (lines 37–52) and let lld-sections.md be authoritative.

themes.title: No quality gates for customer-facing output
themes.root_cause: A customer-facing LLD can ship with empty sections, stale placeholders, or mismatched table counts because there's no validation between gather and compose, and no self-review after composition.
themes.action: Add a data-sufficiency check after gather (report which sections lack data) and a completeness scan after composition (no placeholders, section count matches, table rows match JSON).

themes.title: Missing headless and composability mode
themes.root_cause: The skill is fully scriptable but lacks headless invocation, JSON persistence, and writes only after an unnecessary confirmation round-trip.
themes.action: Add a --headless flag that writes directly and returns a status JSON; persist gathered data as <cluster>-lld.json for downstream consumption; default to writing immediately in interactive mode too.

themes.title: Gather script coverage gap forces model into extraction work
themes.root_cause: gather_lld_data.py doesn't extract metallb-configuration data, forcing the model to read raw YAML overlays and compute which files the script missed — both deterministic operations.
themes.action: Extend gather_lld_data.py to cover metallb-configuration and emit a files_read manifest so the model never needs to diff coverage.

themes.title: Hardcoded templates with no customization surface
themes.root_cause: references/lld-sections.md and assets/style.css contain org-specific content (section structure, brand colors/fonts) with no customize.toml entry point for override.
themes.action: Create customize.toml with lld_sections_template and pdf_style_template override points. Document the contract each template must satisfy.

strengths: Well-drawn intelligence-placement boundary: scripts own extraction (YAML parsing, structured data), model owns synthesis and writing.
Extremely lean SKILL.md at 892 tokens — well under the 1500-token desired budget with no waste patterns or decorative formatting.
Robust gotchas section captures genuine institutional knowledge (typo preservation, secret handling, NMState summarization).
Clean path standards — no bare-bmad references, no absolute paths, no cross-dir dot-slash patterns.
gather_lld_data.py has unit tests and produces clean structured JSON with stderr-only diagnostics.

recommendations.action: Fix H1 Overview to H2 and wire lld-template.md into the Document Composition section; remove inline section list.
Add headless mode (--headless flag), persist JSON dual-output, remove interactive confirmation gate for default flow.
Add data-sufficiency validation after gather and a completeness self-review scan after composition.
Extend gather_lld_data.py to extract metallb-configuration and emit a files_read manifest.
Create customize.toml with lld_sections_template and pdf_style_template points.
Fix {fleet-common} resolution to use {project-root}/.skills/fleet-common and add bare-path preamble to resolution rules.

journeys.name: Interactive LLD generation
journeys.steps: User says 'generate LLD for etl7' → skill gathers data → composes document → writes to file → optionally exports PDF

journeys.name: PDF export
journeys.steps: User says 'export as PDF' after generation → skill runs export_pdf.sh → mermaid diagrams rendered → PDF delivered

experience.headless: Not wired — skill is trivially adaptable (accepts all args, deterministic script) but currently lacks the --headless flag and status JSON contract.

findings.title: Overview uses H1 instead of H2
findings.evidence: Line 6 is `# Overview` (H1) while all other sections use `## …` (H2). Tooling and compaction logic key on `## Overview` specifically.
findings.recommendation: Change `# Overview` to `## Overview`.

findings.title: Missing headless mode — skill is trivially adaptable but unwired
findings.evidence: The skill accepts fully-specified args and runs a deterministic script, yet no headless invocation path exists.
findings.recommendation: Add a --headless flag. When set, skip confirmation and return {"status":"complete","path":"<output>"} as the headless JSON contract.

findings.title: Missing data-sufficiency validation between gather and compose
findings.evidence: The skill transitions from script output directly to document composition with no check that the JSON covers all 15 sections.
findings.recommendation: After gather, validate minimum required fields per section. Report missing data and ask user whether to proceed with reduced document.

findings.title: Template asset exists but is never loaded
findings.evidence: No reference to assets/lld-template.md appears in SKILL.md, references, or scripts.
findings.recommendation: Route to it from Document Composition as the structural skeleton, or delete it.

findings.title: {fleet-common} resolves to ambiguous bare relative path
findings.evidence: Resolution rules define {fleet-common} → .skills/fleet-common. Bare paths resolve from the skill's installed directory, making this resolve to a non-existent nested path.
findings.recommendation: Change to {fleet-common} → {project-root}/.skills/fleet-common.

findings.title: Inline section list duplicates reference file ordering
findings.evidence: The 15-item section list on lines 37–52 is a verbatim copy of what's already in references/lld-sections.md, which line 30 already routes to.
findings.recommendation: Remove the inline enumeration; let references/lld-sections.md be authoritative for section order.

findings.title: Unreferenced template — same as architecture-2
findings.evidence: Duplicate of architecture-2: lld-template.md exists but is never loaded by any skill file.
findings.recommendation: Wire as structural scaffold or delete.

findings.title: Missing composability hook — gathered JSON is not persisted
findings.evidence: The gather script produces structured JSON consumed once by the model and then lost. Downstream skills would need to re-run the script.
findings.recommendation: Save the script JSON alongside the markdown as <cluster-name>-lld.json.

findings.title: Interactive confirmation gate is over-applied
findings.evidence: The user already asked for the LLD explicitly. Forcing a confirmation adds a round-trip with no gain.
findings.recommendation: Default to writing immediately; present summary with path and offer adjustments.

findings.title: Missing lightweight reviewer gate for customer-facing output
findings.evidence: 15 sections composed with no self-review step. Placeholders or miscounted tables could ship to customer.
findings.recommendation: Add a post-composition scan: verify sections populated, no placeholders remain, table counts match JSON.

findings.title: MetalLB overlay not extracted by gather script
findings.evidence: Step 4 asks the model to read metallb-configuration/ overlays — the same deterministic extraction work the script does for trident/nmstate.
findings.recommendation: Extend gather_lld_data.py to extract metallb-configuration data.

findings.title: Model must diff script coverage vs filesystem
findings.evidence: Step 4 says 'Only read files not already captured by the script' — the model must compute what the script missed, a deterministic operation.
findings.recommendation: Have gather script emit a files_read manifest so the model knows exactly what remains.

findings.title: Section template hardcoded with no customize.toml override
findings.evidence: Orgs needing different LLD sections (Compliance, Security Posture, SLA) must fork the skill.
findings.recommendation: Lift to a lld_sections_template customization point in customize.toml.

findings.title: PDF style hardcoded with org-specific brand colors
findings.evidence: Colors #1e3a5f, #1d4ed8, fonts Liberation Sans, and A4 page size are baked in with no override mechanism.
findings.recommendation: Add a pdf_style_template customization point in customize.toml.

findings.title: Three composition bullets restate writing rules from reference
findings.evidence: Tone, tables, and Mermaid bullets duplicate the General Writing Rules block in references/lld-sections.md.
findings.recommendation: Keep only the web-search bullet; the others are covered by the reference.

findings.title: Resolution rules omit bare-path convention preamble
findings.evidence: Bare paths like references/lld-sections.md appear in the body but resolution rules don't state they resolve from the skill root.
findings.recommendation: Add: 'Bare paths (e.g. references/lld-sections.md) resolve from this skill's installed directory.'

findings.title: Inline section list would shadow template override
findings.evidence: If the template were made configurable, the hardcoded list on lines 37–52 would silently override it.
findings.recommendation: Remove inline enumeration; let the template be authoritative.

findings.title: Readme bulk-read partially deterministic
findings.evidence: Step 3 reads every component readme with has_readme=true. The list is deterministic from the JSON but the model chooses how many to read.
findings.recommendation: Consider having gather script extract readme summaries for smaller components.

findings.title: Mermaid regex pattern has no unit test
findings.evidence: The MERMAID_BLOCK_RE regex is untested — edge cases (nested fences, empty blocks) could silently pass through.
findings.recommendation: Add test cases for edge-case Mermaid blocks in scripts/tests/.

findings.title: SVG URL constant defined but unused after PNG switch
findings.evidence: MERMAID_INK_SVG_URL is still defined but the script only uses the PNG endpoint. Dead code.
findings.recommendation: Remove the unused MERMAID_INK_SVG_URL constant.

findings.title: No graceful degradation when mermaid.ink is unreachable
findings.evidence: Individual failures are handled (kept as code block) but no pre-flight check or offline fallback guidance.
findings.recommendation: Add a connectivity pre-check and mention mmdc as an offline alternative in Gotchas.
